about_the_game:
Game Introduction:

Mind Reader: Ghost Trip is a Chinese horror mystery puzzle game. The story takes place on a remote southern island, where a former detective and current game daily reporter comes to visit, only to be caught up in the murder of a well-known game producer. As the investigation deepens, the suspect is quickly arrested, but as the victim's past slowly emerges, the truth of the case becomes murky......

Wei Lian : I 'm a reporter for Game Daily. My name is Wei Lian 殳. I was invited to a deserted island in the south to interview Mr. Lin Kunshi, a renowned game producer.

Wei Lian : I thought I was a well-informed person, and the first thing that caught my eye still shocked me: In the middle of the low dilapidated houses, a huge castle like a Western noble stands alone in the sky.

Wei Lian : I thought THIS would BE a pleasant business trip AND travel, but unexpectedly got involved in A murder case of a famous game producer.

Wei Lian : As the investigation progresses, the suspect is quickly caught, but as the victim 's past gradually comes to light, the truth of the case becomes confusing......
